description:
Crypto spot ETF net flows per day (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE) over the last lookback_days (default 30, up to 3650), newest first, with per-asset totals for the whole window. Persistent net inflows are a bullish tape signal; heavy outflows bearish. Pass symbol to narrow it to one asset. Days are paged: limit 1-100 (default 25), offset 0-10000; the totals always cover every day in the window. Use it when the user asks about ETF flows, institutional demand or spot ETF activity.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

lookback_days.description: Number of days of history to request.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_etf_flows
